update rabbits r inner join global_setting gs on gs.house_id = r.house_id set r.growth_stage = case when date_add( r.growth_stage_entered_at, interval (gs.adaptation_days + gs.growing_days + gs.fattening_days) day ) <= #{now} then 'MATURE' when date_add( r.growth_stage_entered_at, interval (gs.adaptation_days + gs.growing_days) day ) <= #{now} then 'FATTENING' when date_add( r.growth_stage_entered_at, interval gs.adaptation_days day ) <= #{now} then 'GROWING' else 'ADAPTATION' end, r.state_version = r.state_version + 1, r.update_by = #{updateBy}, r.update_time = now() where r.house_id = #{houseId} and r.is_active = true and r.type = '2' and r.growth_stage_entered_at is not null and r.growth_stage <> case when date_add( r.growth_stage_entered_at, interval (gs.adaptation_days + gs.growing_days + gs.fattening_days) day ) <= #{now} then 'MATURE' when date_add( r.growth_stage_entered_at, interval (gs.adaptation_days + gs.growing_days) day ) <= #{now} then 'FATTENING' when date_add( r.growth_stage_entered_at, interval gs.adaptation_days day ) <= #{now} then 'GROWING' else 'ADAPTATION' end
